en-US.description:
RTSH TANI brings Albania's public broadcaster to your phone and tablet. Watch all 19 RTSH television channels live, listen to 13 radio stations, and never miss a programme again.

LIVE TELEVISION
Stream every RTSH channel live in adaptive quality that adjusts to your connection. Pick your own quality when you want to, or let the app handle it.

RADIO THAT KEEPS PLAYING
All 13 RTSH radio stations, with full background playback and lock-screen controls. Lock your phone, switch apps, keep listening.

FULL TV GUIDE
Browse the complete schedule for every channel, seven days back and seven days ahead. Open any programme for its full description.

CATCH-UP
Missed something? Play it back from the guide. Pause, rewind and scrub through any recorded programme.

BUILT FOR EVERY SCREEN
Designed for iPhone and iPad, with picture-in-picture so you can keep watching while you do something else.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Albanian by default, with English available. Light and dark themes.

PARENTAL CONTROLS
Set a PIN on this device to gate age-restricted programming.

RTSH TANI is the official application of Radio Televizioni Shqiptar. An account is required. Some content may not be available in all regions.

review.notes:
RTSH TANI is the official OTT application of Radio Televizioni Shqiptar (RTSH), Albania's national public broadcaster. It streams RTSH's own live TV and radio channels plus catch-up of previously aired programming.

CONTENT AVAILABILITY: RTSH holds broadcast rights primarily for Albania, so some channels are geo-restricted. TODO(anx 2026-08-06): confirm with backend whether the review account is exempted from geo-restriction before submitting — a US-based reviewer hitting a geo-block screen is an Apple 2.1 rejection.

HOW TO REVIEW:
1. Sign in with the credentials above.
2. Home tab — tap any channel tile to start live playback. Use the Radio toggle to switch to radio stations.
3. Guide tab — the full 7-day programme schedule. Tap a past programme to play it back (catch-up).
4. Player — tap the screen for controls. The options sheet has quality selection and audio tracks.
5. Radio continues playing in the background and on the lock screen; this is intentional and is the app's core radio feature.

FEATURES THAT MAY PROMPT QUESTIONS:
- Cellular data gate: Settings has a "play over cellular" toggle. When off, a confirmation modal appears before playback starts on a cellular connection. Tap Continue to proceed.
- Parental control: Settings — Parental control sets a device-level PIN that gates age-restricted programmes. It is stored only on the device and never sent to our servers. It is off by default.
- Advertising: short pre-roll and mid-roll ads may appear. These are RTSH's own promotional spots served from our backend; no third-party ad SDK is used.
- Account deletion is available in-app: Profile — Delete account.
